description: On-demand staleness check for a memory file claim. Reads the memory file, dispatches a native haiku-researcher utility to verify the claim against current code, and returns a structured verdict (FRESH | STALE | CONTRADICTED | INCONCLUSIVE) with file:line evidence. Call before acting on any backlog item from memory. Spec: docs/specs/2026-04-08-gossip-verify-memory.md

_utility_task_id.description: Internal: utility task ID for re-entry after native haiku dispatch

claim.description: The specific memory assertion to verify against current code.

memory_path.description: Path to memory file (relative to cwd or absolute). Absolute paths must resolve inside cwd or under ~/.claude/projects/.

name: gossip_verify_memory
